Name: multi_firm_tariff_impact_model
Title: Multi-Firm Dynamic Equilibrium Analysis of Japanese Auto Tariffs
Experiment: Extend the partial equilibrium model to incorporate multiple Japanese car manufacturers with different market shares and cost structures. Implement a dynamic response mechanism where manufacturers can adjust prices and production over time in response to tariffs. This will provide a more nuanced analysis of how the 25% tariff affects different manufacturers and captures strategic interactions between firms that influence market value impact.
